title: OTHRYS OS mission slices and completion contracts
goal: Expose real mission slices, owners and declared artifacts in Work State so completion criteria are visible before execution.
laws: Slices and declared artifacts come from the mission envelope.
Artifact presence is evidence, not authority.
A slice may be visible as complete only from deterministic local evidence.
Owners are descriptive routing intent only.
Missing declared artifacts remain visibly incomplete.
No execution, transition, accept, reject or release authority is added.
Existing Trust Canal and Refine boundaries remain unchanged.
